## Setup: ChatGPT (OpenAI API)
- Log in at platform.openai.com and open **API keys** (platform.openai.com/api-keys)
- Click **Create new secret key**, name it (e.g. n8n) and copy it
- In n8n: open **Ask ChatGPT**, credential > **Create new** > OpenAI
- Paste the key in **API Key**. Organization ID: only if you belong to several orgs
- Add credit under Billing. Without it calls fail with "too many requests" (insufficient_quota)
- Model gpt-5-mini with web search on (change in the node if you like)

## Setup: Claude (Anthropic API)
- Log in at console.anthropic.com > **Settings > API Keys**
- Click **+ Create Key**, name it (e.g. n8n-integration), click **Copy Key**
- In n8n: open **Ask Claude**, credential > **Create new** > Anthropic
- Paste the key in **API Key** and save
- Make sure the Console account has credit (Billing), or calls fail
- Web search is switched on inside the node

## Setup: Perplexity API
- Log in to your Perplexity account and create an API key (guide: docs.perplexity.ai/guides/getting-started)
- Add a payment method / credit for the API
- In n8n: open **Ask Perplexity**, credential > **Create new** > Perplexity, paste the key
- "Test connection" can show **Forbidden**: ignore it. The test uses an old endpoint; the node itself works
- The node sends 1 call every 3 seconds to stay under Perplexity's rate limit

## Setup: Gemini (Google AI Studio)
- Go to aistudio.google.com/apikey
- Click **Create API Key** (new or existing Google Cloud project) and copy it
- Turn on billing for that project. The free tier hits quota fast (429 errors)
- In n8n: open **Ask Gemini**, credential > **Create new** > Google Gemini(PaLM) API
- Paste the key in **API Key**. Keep Host as https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com
- Google Search grounding is switched on inside the node

## Setup: Google Sheets (create these first)
Copying this template? Create **2 spreadsheets** in Google Drive. Header names go in **row 1**, spelled exactly as below (lowercase, underscores).

### Spreadsheet 1: Prompts (e.g. "AI Visibility Prompts")
**Tab: Sheet1** (one row per question you want to ask the AI tools)
- **prompt_id**: number, e.g. 1, 2, 3
- **prompt**: the question, e.g. "What are the best AI marketing courses?"
- **prompt_type**: group name, e.g. Brand, Industry, Customer problems
- **active**: TRUE to include, FALSE to skip (empty column = all included)
Tip: prompt_type "Brand" runs once per tool (set in Config > single_run_prompt_types); all other types run 5 times (change in Config)

### Spreadsheet 2: Run Log (e.g. "AI Visibility Run Log")
Leave the data rows empty. The workflow fills them.
**Tab: Answers** (one row per AI answer)
timestamp, week, week_start, run_id, mode, prompt_id, prompt, prompt_type, provider, run_number, brand_mentioned, status, error, answer

**Tab: Mention Rates** (one row per prompt per AI tool, plus an "ALL" total per tool)
week, week_start, run_id, mode, prompt_id, prompt, prompt_type, provider, responses, mentions, failed, mention_rate

### Connect in n8n
- Open any Sheets node > credential > **Create new** > Google Sheets OAuth2 > **Sign in with Google**
- Use an account that can **edit** both spreadsheets; select the same credential on all 4 Sheets nodes
- **Read Prompts**: pick spreadsheet 1, tab Sheet1
- **Save Answers**: spreadsheet 2, tab Answers
- **Read Previous Rates** + **Save Mention Rates**: spreadsheet 2, tab Mention Rates
- Tab names must match exactly (Answers, Mention Rates); columns are matched by header name

## Setup: Slack connection
- In n8n: open **Post Slack Summary**, credential > **Create new** > Slack OAuth2 API
- Click **Connect my account**
- Choose where the report goes: **Send Message To** 
- For a channel: pick it from the list. If Slack says not_in_channel, add the n8n app to that channel
